package imported_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/imported/gen/credentials"
	server "example.com/imported/gen/http/credentials/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/security"
)

type partialImplementation struct {
	svc.Service
	calls      int
	auth       []string
	denySecond bool
}

func (s *partialImplementation) Public(context.Context) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}

func (s *partialImplementation) OauthRoles(context.Context, *svc.OauthRolesPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}

func (s *partialImplementation) OAuth2Auth(ctx context.Context, token string, scheme *security.OAuth2Scheme) (context.Context, error) {
	s.auth = append(s.auth, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%v", scheme.Name, token, scheme.RequiredScopes))
	if token != "token" || s.denySecond && scheme.Name == "OAuthSecond" {
		return ctx, fmt.Errorf("OAuth denied")
	}
	return ctx, nil
}

func TestPartialCredentialAuthWire(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, path, token string
		denySecond        bool
		calls, status     int
		auth              []string
	}{
		{name: "public", path: "/public", calls: 1, status: 204},
		{name: "scoped conjunction", path: "/oauth_roles", token: "token", calls: 1, status: 204,
			auth: []string{"OAuth:token:[read]", "OAuthSecond:token:[read]"}},
		{name: "second role denies", path: "/oauth_roles", token: "token", denySecond: true,
			auth: []string{"OAuth:token:[read]", "OAuthSecond:token:[read]"}},
		{name: "missing credential", path: "/oauth_roles", auth: []string{"OAuth::[read]"}},
		{name: "inherited unsupported omitted", path: "/inherit", status: 404},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &partialImplementation{denySecond: tc.denySecond}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(s), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tc.path, nil)
			if tc.token != "" {
				req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+tc.token)
			}
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
			if s.calls != tc.calls || !reflect.DeepEqual(s.auth, tc.auth) {
				t.Errorf("calls=%d auth=%v; want calls=%d auth=%v", s.calls, s.auth, tc.calls, tc.auth)
			}
			if tc.status != 0 && rec.Code != tc.status || tc.status == 0 && rec.Code < 400 {
				t.Errorf("status=%d expected=%d body=%s", rec.Code, tc.status, rec.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
